in_marathi.name: Gokila
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cow of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gokila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gokila is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gau’ which means cow and ‘kila’ which means power. The name signifies the one who possesses the divine power of a cow, which is associated with nourishment, abundance, and protection.
